in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जयति (jayati) - he conquers, ईन् (ein) - this; जयन् (jayan) - He who conquers

in_marathi.name: Jayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya' which means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. The name is used in Hindu mythology for various gods and figures who symbolize success, triumph, and power.
